scripts.db:migrate: pnpm dlx wrangler --cwd packages/core d1 migrations apply DB --remote
scripts.db:migrations:list: pnpm dlx wrangler --cwd packages/core d1 migrations list DB --remote
scripts.db:verify:tables: pnpm dlx wrangler --cwd packages/core d1 execute DB --remote --command "SELECT name FROM sqlite_master WHERE type='table';"
